derivation: from (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259 (ἅλωσις);
def: properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive

occurrences.text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
